audit.limitation: Same declared finite corpus and sign-exchangeability assumptions; not universal optimality

interpretation: Fixed is the reproducible working configuration, not a proven optimal rule set or universal winner.
The registered adaptive-superiority criterion did not pass; this does not establish equivalence.
The 160 continuations form 16 paired source blocks, not 160 independent theories.
The held-out corpus shares Metamath ancestry with development data; it is not all of Metamath or ZFC.
These are future-utility outcomes, distinct from initial coverage and descriptive network metrics.

protocol.fixed_control: Lock a quota-matched set ranked on old development DAGs; also retain the whole fixed extended grammar and a random quota control. All arms receive the COMPLETE <=2-MP set and identical inherited compressed core.
protocol.inference: 16 paired source RNG blocks, not independent axiom systems; exact one-sided sign-flip tests assume exchangeable paired signs. Intersection of future and total tests (max p), Holm across three controls, alpha .05. No optional stopping.
protocol.primary: For each source, take the common held-out residual uncovered by EVERY initial arm; average two neutral policies; count newly covered residual targets by 60 growth CPU-s. Only future performance, not initial coverage or build output, determines success.
protocol.primary_total: Repeat the SAME endpoint at 90 total cold CPU-s, including newly measured common source build/read, catalogue cold synthesis/verification (charged in full, not amortised), method preparation/selection/merge/compression/certification and continuation setup. Inherited historical library/model training remains excluded and disclosed.
protocol.quota_scope: Quota limits added >=3-MP catalogue outputs in two matched controls and adaptive, NOT total skeleton size or compression threshold. Positive-marginal upper coding remains unlimited.
protocol.representation: The neutral mixed continuer includes the existing ID-dependent frontier sampler. This compares delivered interfaces under that fixed engine, not a representation-invariant semantic quality functional.
protocol.timing_scope: Measured operational parent+verifier-child CPU, not wall time or all historical research costs. Interpreter startup, filesystem wall waits, offline held-out observer, terminal bulk future export and audit remain separately reported; never claim whole-job or from-axioms ATP acceleration.
